chain.title: Found Growing Wild
chain.desc: Wild cucumbers spawn in the world the way Farmer's Delight's wild cabbages do. Knifing them is how the crop line starts.

chain.title: Saving The Seed
chain.desc: Cut from wild cucumbers. Cucumber is the mod's most-used vegetable and the only one that ferments.

chain.title: The First Harvest
chain.desc: Grown from seed on farmland. It appears in the tacos, the salad and every roll in the sushi line.

chain.title: Sliced Thin
chain.desc: Knife a cucumber on a cutting board. Slices are what the rolls actually take.

chain.title: Left In The Barrel
chain.desc: Cucumber put through Farmer's Delight fermentation. The only fermented crop in the mod and the one that keeps.

chain.title: Corn In The Wild
chain.desc: Wild corn is the second of the three wild patches this mod seeds into worldgen.

chain.title: An Ear Of Corn
chain.desc: Grown from the wild patch. Corn is the mod's staple grain and the base of tortillas, popcorn and elote.

chain.title: Stripping The Cob
chain.desc: Knife a corn cob and it gives kernels and Farmer's Delight straw. Kernels replant, and they pop.

chain.title: Kernels Over A Campfire
chain.desc: Campfire-cook the kernels. The fastest snack in the Farmer's Delight ecosystem.

chain.title: Masa
chain.desc: Corn with a water bucket. Corn dough is a separate dough from Farmer's Delight's wheat dough and the tortilla depends on it.

chain.title: The Flatbread Everything Wraps In
chain.desc: Made from corn dough. Every taco, burrito and wrap in the mod runs through it.

chain.title: Folded And Filled
chain.desc: Tortilla, cooked chicken, cucumber, corn, onion and tomato sauce. The mod's signature dish.

chain.title: Eggplant, Wild
chain.desc: The third wild patch. Eggplant is the mod's most temperamental crop and has a white variant.

chain.title: Grown Purple
chain.desc: From seed. Eggplant is the base of the parmesan and the burger, and it smokes into three different products.

chain.title: Baked In A Dish
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: eggplants, raw pasta, tomato sauce, bread, egg and milk. A feast-sized block that needs Farmer's Delight's whole pantry.

chain.title: Planting An Avocado
chain.desc: Avocado trees are this mod's only tree, with their own log, wood, leaves and a fruiting leaf state.

chain.title: The Fruit Itself
chain.desc: Harvested from fruiting avocado leaves. It has a pit that replants and appears in a third of the recipes here.

chain.title: Saving The Stone
chain.desc: Squeezed out of an avocado. Plant it for the next tree.

chain.title: Halved
chain.desc: Knife an avocado. Cut avocado is what the toast, the burrito and the rolls actually consume.

chain.title: The Obvious Joke
chain.desc: Cut avocado on bread. Every pack that ships this mod has this quest whether it wants to or not.

chain.title: Green Roll
chain.desc: Avocado, cucumber, Farmer's Delight cooked rice and dried kelp. The first of the sushi line.

chain.title: One Of Each
chain.desc: The medley needs the whole roll family assembled, which makes it the mod's completion dish.

chain.title: Rolled And Sealed
chain.desc: Tortilla, cooked rice, cooked beef and avocado. The heaviest single meal in the mod.

chain.title: With Ginger
chain.desc: Ginger is the mod's one spice, and the curry is the only recipe that uses it.

notes: 69 ids resolve as assets/culturaldelights/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys. The three wild patches (wild_corn, wild_cucumbers, wild_eggplants) are the entry points, exactly mirroring Farmer's Delight's own wild_cabbages/wild_tomatoes pattern, which is why they open the chain. Ordering read from data/culturaldelights/recipes/: farmersdelight:cutting for the seed and slice steps, farmersdelight:cooking for the pot dishes, and farmersdelight:fermenting for the pickle - the only fermented item in this set. corn_dough is a SEPARATE dough from farmersdelight's wheat dough (corn plus a water bucket) and is what the tortilla, and therefore the whole taco/burrito/wrap branch, depends on. Two loot modifiers add squid and glow squid drops (culturaldelights:squid and glow_squid), which feed the calamari line. The three lang-only ids (corn, cucumbers, eggplants) are crop block states rather than items and are excluded, as are avocado_leaf_carpet, bamboo_mat and fried_eggplant_pasta which have models but no lang key in this build. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:cooked_rice, farmersdelight:tomato_sauce, farmersdelight:raw_pasta, farmersdelight:tomato and onion crops, a barrel for farmersdelight:fermenting, any forge:tools/knives knife.
